name: Anglers Loot
summary: Fishing pays off more often, with half the junk, more treasure and a rare chance at a heart of the sea.
logoPrompt: A small open wooden treasure chest dripping with water, a fishing hook caught on its lid and a glowing blue orb inside, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Less junk, more treasure on every cast.
bullets: Heart of the sea and XP bottles

description: **Anglers Loot makes fishing more rewarding: about half as much junk, more treasure and two new treasure catches.**
- About half as much junk: leather boots, bowls and rotten flesh come up half as often as in vanilla.
- Treasure comes about one and a half times as often, still only in open water.
- New treasure catches: the rare heart of the sea and bottles o' enchanting, one to three at a time.
- Enchanted books, saddles, name tags and the other vanilla treasures stay about as likely as before.
- Luck of the Sea still helps: at level III you catch no junk at all.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Then fish with any fishing rod.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 and 1.21.1. Works with every fishing rod, in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- It changes the vanilla fishing loot, so another pack that changes fishing loot can override it or be overridden by it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
